title: Choose where to work
description: You can access multiple customer environments or HR groups. Choose the context for this session.
formDescription: Your choice determines which customer environment and HR group you use in this session.
tenantDescription: Choose the customer environment you are working for today.
hrGroupDescription: Then select the HR group within this customer environment.
sessionHint: Your choice is securely saved for this session.
noAccess: No active HR context is available.
failed: The context could not be saved. Choose again.
invalid: Choose a valid customer environment and HR group.
